name: Hybrid Particle-Level Set Method
definition: A liquid animation method that combines marker particles and a dynamic level set to track the liquid surface, addressing the mass dissipation issue of Stam's method and providing realistic, stable liquids.
summary: The Hybrid Particle-Level Set Method is a liquid animation technique that combines massless marker particles with a dynamic level set function to track surfaces, addressing mass dissipation and providing high detail with volume conservation.
